highlights: The local API now requires a per-install token — other accounts on your machine can no longer drive it
Hand-cancelling an engine order can no longer abandon a live deal (both bypasses closed)
Install an exact commit with BOROS_REF, and see which one you're running in Settings → About
Windows key-file permissions no longer revert on every boot; a source checkout is no longer chmod'ed
The macOS installers stop killing unrelated processes that merely mention the server path
